create_DiskWriter: create a DiskWriter instance to save documents to disk with configurable output folder and compression
run_DiskWriter: run a DiskWriter pipeline to write documents from a DocumentsPipeline to disk with rank-based file splitting
write_Document: write a Document to disk using a DiskWriter with automatic filename generation and metadata-based path substitution
test_is_retryable_hf_hub_error: test the is_retryable_hf_hub_error method to determine if an HF Hub exception should be retried with exponential backoff
review_DiskWriter: review the DiskWriter base class and its _write abstract method for implementing custom disk writer subclasses
